verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe Incoming Webhooks as a way to post messages from external apps to a Teams channel via a webhook URL (ms-teams-docs-36, ms-teams-docs-12, ms-teams-docs-44, ms-teams-docs-30), matching the story's ask. However, hands-on community feedback contradicts the 'simple' framing, stating that real API integration with Teams 'requires the full Azure/Graph API stack unlike Slack's simple webhooks' (ms-teams-comm-11), indicating the webhook path is not as frictionless as documented. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that incoming webhook setup is as simple in practice as the docs claim, and clarity on whether legacy Incoming Webhooks/connectors remain fully supported going forward.
